sections.heading: Contraindications and interactions
sections.content: Training-only interaction guidance: concurrent clarithromycin requires pharmacist review before atorvastatin is continued or adjusted. This statement is synthetic and does not replace an approved medication policy.

sections.heading: Monitoring
sections.content: Review reported muscle symptoms, the active medication list, and the locally approved monitoring workflow. Escalate unresolved interaction risk to an authorized clinician.

sections.heading: Renal monitoring
sections.content: Training-only monitoring guidance: review renal function according to local policy before treatment decisions. Coordinate laboratory trends with the current medication plan.

sections.heading: Follow-up
sections.content: Document adherence questions and route clinically significant changes to an authorized clinician. No patient-specific recommendation is made by this synthetic monograph.

sections.heading: Coordinated review
sections.content: Coordinate diabetes treatment decisions with adherence review, laboratory trends, medication tolerance, and shared decision-making. Use the approved clinical workflow for escalation.

sections.heading: Monitoring plan
sections.content: Record the responsible follow-up role and the next review point. Reconcile the treatment plan with current formulary guidance and validated laboratory evidence.

sections.heading: Therapy review
sections.content: Review medication tolerance and interaction risk before changing lipid therapy. Confirm exact drug names against the approved formulary source.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.content: Escalate unresolved adverse-effect or interaction concerns through the authorized clinical workflow and retain source citations in the review record.

sections.heading: Interpretation
sections.content: Training-only reference: interpret A1C ranges and trends with the approved clinical protocol. This synthetic source intentionally does not assert a patient threshold.

sections.heading: Follow-up
sections.content: When the approved protocol identifies a follow-up range, coordinate the laboratory finding with adherence review, treatment context, and an authorized clinician.

sections.heading: Monitoring context
sections.content: Training-only renal reference: preserve the reported test name, unit, range, and collection context when applying an approved monitoring workflow.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.content: Route clinically significant renal trends to an authorized clinician and reconcile the finding with medications that require renal monitoring.
